nodes.text:
🧵HMPV Outbreak Alert : Here's what you MUST do to protect yourself.👇
1️⃣Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is spreading fast!
Originating from China, HMPV cases are now being reported in India.
This respiratory virus can cause severe illness in kids, seniors & those with weak immunity https://t.co/T0P1JnHTpQ

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
2️⃣ What is HMPV?

HMPV is a respiratory virus that causes cold-like symptoms but can lead to serious illness like bronchitis/pneumonia.
It's similar to RSV & spreads through coughing, sneezing and close contact.

🚨 Warning: There’s no vaccine yet, so prevention is best defense. https://t.co/bk5ynLFlfo

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
3️⃣ Symptoms to Watch For
👃Runny nose
😷Cough
🤒Fever
🫁 Breathing difficulty
🧸Wheezing (in children)
If you or your child show these signs and it worsens, seek medical attention immediately.🚑

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
4️⃣ What You Should Do to Protect Yourself
✅Wash hands frequently with soap for 20+ seconds.
✅Wear a mask in crowded places.
✅Disinfect surfaces regularly.
✅Maintain distance from those with respiratory symptoms.
✅Get enough sleep, eat healthy, and boost immunity.
#HealthTips https://t.co/L7xZ67xWKe

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
5️⃣ What You Should NOT Do
🚫Don’t ignore persistent cough or breathing issues.
🚫Don’t send sick kids to school.
🚫Don’t visit crowded places if you feel unwell.
🚫Don’t self-medicate if symptoms worsen—seek medical advice.
#ProtectYourFamily
#PreventiveCare
#ImmuneHealth

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
6️⃣ Who Is Most at Risk?
🔴Children under 5
🔴Seniors (65+)
🔴People with chronic illnesses (asthma, diabetes, heart conditions)
🔴Individuals with weakened immune systems

These groups need EXTRA precautions. Ensure they are protected.🛡️
